title: NASA Black Marble (2016): Earth at night, color composite
orientation: north-to-south rows; -180 to +180 longitude columns; antimeridian at the seam
memoryNote: Nominal RGBA8 full mip chain; excludes driver padding and decoded CPU image memory.

source.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / Joshua Stevens; Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Román, NASA GSFC
source.note: Historical 2016 night-light composite selected from cloud-free nights. Not live weather or one simultaneous full-globe photograph. No added clouds, glow, sharpening or color adjustments.

preparation.processing: Lanczos3 downsample from verified 13500×6750 GeoTIFF; sRGB; remove alpha; JPEG quality 90, mozjpeg, 4:4:4 chroma; strip metadata; no geographic flip or crop; no upscaling or artistic enhancement.
